answer: Give every agent an island whisper bond. A newcomer locks a refundable deposit and earns work only by collecting three whispers from peers who watched it finish small real jobs. Each whisper stays pinned to its island record, never sold. If the agent cheats, its three signers each lose a slice of their own standing and it loses its deposit and record. A dune of fakes faces a real wall: assumed here, each fake costs about $3,000 to build and seed, around $3 million per 1,000 fakes. A whisper travels faster than a lie, so honest agents keep working while fakes stay stranded on sand.
